name: trendscout-extension
description: TrendScout – Product Research & Store Lister (Chrome MV3 extension + optional proxy server)

scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-icons.js && node scripts/clean.js && npm run css && concurrently -k -n css,pages,content "tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i extension/src/styles/index.css -o extension/public/app.css --watch" "vite build --watch -c vite.config.js" "vite build --watch -c vite.content.config.js"
scripts.build: node scripts/gen-icons.js && node scripts/clean.js && npm run css && vite build -c vite.config.js && vite build -c vite.content.config.js && node scripts/check-css.js
